feed.title: Heat pull Bam Adebayo (hip) early in win, don't expect long-term issue
feed.text: Heat star Bam Adebayo did not play in the second half of Monday's win over the Rockets due to hip tightness, but the team doesn't expect a long-term issue.

feed.title: Embiid has season-high 37 and Brown adds 31 as 76ers beat Nets 135-123 without LeBron James
feed.text: — Joel Embiid scored a season-high 37 points, Jaylen Brown matched his season best with 31 and the superstars provided the Philadelphia 76ers with more than enough in LeBron James' absence to beat the Brooklyn Nets 135-123 on Monday night.

feed.title: Terrence Shannon Jr. scores career-high 34 points as Timberwolves beat Trail Blazers 106-98
feed.text: — Terrence Shannon Jr. scored 12 of his career-high 34 points in the second quarter as the Minnesota Timberwolves recovered from a slow start to beat the Portland Trail Blazers 106-98 on Monday night in the opener of a two-game set.

feed.title: Fears' first triple-double leads the Pelicans past the Warriors 115-94
feed.text: — Jeremiah Fears had 19 points, 10 assists and 10 rebounds for his first career triple-double, and the New Orleans Pelicans snapped a six-game losing streak with a 115-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Monday night.

feed.title: Bane scores 24, Magic rally in 4th quarter to beat Celtics 115-105, extend win streak to 4 games
feed.text: — Desmond Bane had 24 points and eight rebounds to help the Orlando Magic rally in the fourth quarter and earn their fourth consecutive victory, 115-105 over the Boston Celtics on Monday night.

feed.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo scores 20, Heat roll past Rockets 128-110 for 5th straight win
feed.text: — Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 20 points and grabbed 13 rebounds, Andrew Wiggins and Klay Thompson each scored 17 and the Miami Heat never trailed on the way to beating the Houston Rockets 128-110 on Monday night for their fifth straight victory.

feed.title: Mitchell and Allen power the Cavaliers to a 126-115 win over the Bulls
feed.text: — Donovan Mitchell scored 39 points and Jarrett Allen added 13 points and 14 rebounds as the Cleveland Cavaliers overcame an early deficit and beat the Chicago Bulls 126-115 on Monday night.
